description: The figure presents a bar chart illustrating classification accuracy for different model variants on the PHEME dataset, with categories arranged along the horizontal axis as labeled bars (including “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition”), and accuracy shown on the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” using a linear scale with visible tick marks spanning roughly from 75 to 95. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored vertical bar with a numeric value printed above it; in the PHEME panel, “Ours” is a dark red bar at 89.84, “w/o comments” is orange at 86.82, “w/o text” is pale yellow at 80.10, “w/o select” is very light blue at 88.80, “w/o emotion” is medium blue at 87.34, and “w/o cognition” is dark blue at 87.17. The bars appear in the labeled order shown on the x-axis rather than being sorted by height, and there are no additional visual emphasis elements such as outlines, annotations beyond the value labels, or stacked/grouped components.
